lua kodu 1:
local Vector = {}
Vector.__index = Vector

function Vector.new(x, y)
    return setmetatable({x = x or 0, y = y or 0}, Vector)
end

function Vector.__add(a, b)
    return Vector.new(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end

local v1 = Vector.new(10, 20)
local v2 = Vector.new(5, -3)
local v3 = v1 + v2
print(v3.x, v3.y)

local function makeCounter(start, step)
    local val = start or 0
    local increment = step or 1
    return function()
        val = val + increment
        return val
    end
end

local c = makeCounter(100, 5)
c()
local result = c()

    local a, b = 0, 1
    while true do
        coroutine.yield(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    end

lua kodu 4:
local function flatten(tbl, res)
    res = res or {}
    for _, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
            flatten(v, res)
        else
            table.insert(res, v)
        end
    end
    return res
end

local raw = {1, {2, {3, 4}}, 5, {6}}
local flat = flatten(raw)

lua kodu 5:
local function safeDivision(a, b)
    local status, err = pcall(function()
        if b == 0 then error("ZeroDivisionError") end
        return a / b
    end)
    
    if not status then
        return nil, err
    end
    return err
end

local res, err = safeDivision(10, 0)
